info.description: Production-ready API boilerplate built with Gin, GORM, and Redis.
info.title: Gin Boilerplate API

post.description: Authenticate user with email and password, returning JWT access token and refresh token
Revoke access token by adding it to the blacklist and optionally revoke the refresh token

parameters.description: Optional refresh token to revoke alongside access token
parameters.name: request

post.description: Exchange a valid refresh token for a newly issued access token and rotated refresh token

401.description: Unauthorized - Invalid, expired or revoked refresh token

post.description: Create a new user account with name, email and password. Assigns default User role.

get.description: Retrieve paginated active refresh token sessions for the authenticated user, with optional filters and sorting

422.description: Unprocessable Entity - Invalid filter or sorting parameter

get.description: Get paginated list of available system permissions with optional filters and sorting. Requires 'view_permission' permission.

422.description: Unprocessable Entity - Invalid filter or sorting parameter

get.description: Get paginated list of roles with optional filters and sorting. Requires 'view_role' permission.

422.description: Unprocessable Entity - Invalid filter or sorting parameter

post.description: Create a new unique role. Requires 'create_role' permission.

get.description: Retrieve detailed information of a role including assigned permissions by UUID. Requires 'view_role' permission.

put.description: Update role information by UUID. Requires 'update_role' permission.

422.description: Unprocessable Entity - Invalid UUID format or request payload

delete.description: Delete a role by UUID. Requires 'delete_role' permission.

post.description: Assign one or more permissions to a role by permission UUIDs. Requires 'add_role_permission' permission.

422.description: Unprocessable Entity - Invalid UUID format or request payload

delete.description: Remove one or more permissions from a role by permission UUIDs. Requires 'remove_role_permission' permission.

422.description: Unprocessable Entity - Invalid UUID format or request payload

get.description: Get paginated list of users with optional filtering and sorting. Requires 'view_user' permission.

422.description: Unprocessable Entity - Invalid filter or sorting parameter

get.description: Get current authenticated user profile details

put.description: Update current authenticated user profile details (e.g. name)

get.description: Retrieve detailed user profile including assigned roles by UUID. Requires 'view_user' permission.

delete.description: Delete a user by UUID. Requires 'delete_user' permission.

post.description: Assign one or more roles to a user by role UUIDs. Requires 'add_user_role' permission.

422.description: Unprocessable Entity - Invalid UUID format or request payload

delete.description: Remove one or more assigned roles from a user by role UUIDs. Requires 'remove_user_role' permission.

422.description: Unprocessable Entity - Invalid UUID format or request payload
